QuestInfo.name: The Desert Destroyers
QuestInfo.0: SagaT who has born and raised in Ariant complains that Ariant has changed too much. What can be the problem?
QuestInfo.1: SagaT said Ariant used to be a wilderness, until the Desert Rabbits appeared and ate all the vegetation. He claimed that was what turned Ariant into a desert. Alpha and Beta needed to hunt down #r#o2600100##k and #r#o2600101##k monsters to prevent Ariant from being destroyed even further.
QuestInfo.2: Alpha and Beta took care of some Desert Rabbits but it was only a matter of time before they returned.

0.0: My beautiful Ariant was once a wilderness, covered in greenery! There were lakes and grass and lush vegetation!
0.1: But then the #rDesert Rabbits#k appeared! They ate and chomped and crunched and munched, and now Ariant is a desert! If we don't stop them, there won't be a single piece of greenery left! Please help!

yes.0: Go through #b#MDmirrorD_322_0_##k to find countless #r#o2600100##k and #r#o2600101##k monsters. Destroy at least #r15 of each#k to give Ariant a chance to stay green!

no.0: I'm afraid they're going to start munching on people when they run out of things to chew on.

1.0: Did you get all the Desert Rabbits?

yes.0: We can't get rid of all Desert Rabbits, but we managed to take out a good chunk. This is all thanks to you.

default.0: Hunt #r15#k #r#o2600100##k and #r#o2600101##k monsters before it's too late!
